Who’s there?”"}, {"id": "043-020-0004", "tag": "p", "text": "I says:", "sha256": "0e568af30022d4c6b08be6c92743d85cbf120134610018b892e098e0fe72f7eb", "source_location": "div.chapter[22]/*[4]", "source_html": "I says:"}, {"id": "043-020-0005", "tag": "p", "text": "“It’s me.”", "sha256": "9a6667f7d13b4472b9483435994c5184e9c87f2e0c3717d478711bc38ad9d570", "source_location": "div.chapter[22]/*[5]", "source_html": "“It’s me.”"}, {"id": "043-020-0006", "tag": "p", "text": "“Who’s me?”", "sha256": "ec3534be495755274829d56e60d6573af1d582121f5ff13ca710f328dbecc201", "source_location": "div.chapter[22]/*[6]", "source_html": "“Who’s me?”"}, {"id": "043-020-0007", "tag": "p", "text": "“George Jackson, sir.”", "sha256": "6d0b2403ade43ee63a16e4a3adccdf55c52a79daaf9d5d41a9c4a2e753a0471b", "source_location": "div.chapter[22]/*[7]", "source_html": "“George Jackson, sir.”"}, {"id": "043-020-0008", "tag": "p", "text": "“What do you want?”", "sha256": "5af79f76f6b5043e967383b4ebbc976dcb4f8f9efcb66196e8fca17f326061c7", "source_location": "div.chapter[22]/*[8]", "source_html": "“What do you want?”"}, {"id": "043-020-0009", "tag": "p", "text": "“I don’t want nothing, sir. I only want to go along by, but the dogs won’t let me.”", "sha256": "0bff8040f1be86be586cd3e5101060dc1f9b6cba03a73634283123b7a75920fb", "source_location": "div.chapter[22]/*[9]", "source_html": "“I don’t want nothing, sir. I only want to go along by, but the dogs won’t let me.”"}, {"id": "043-020-0010", "tag": "p", "text": "“What are you prowling around here this time of night for—hey?”", "sha256": "bb5d19e8504ff710ff4bfb139aa907b0fe633fa4e03de56f9bf430a24224713b", "source_location": "div.chapter[22]/*[10]", "source_html": "“What are you prowling around here this time of night for—hey?”"}, {"id": "043-020-0011", "tag": "p", "text": "“I warn’t prowling around, sir, I fell overboard off of the steamboat.”", "sha256": "aedac23bb0edef0bcdd555e6866259c55fa96d26bd0b510d003785ea781ec700", "source_location": "div.chapter[22]/*[11]", "source_html": "“I warn’t prowling around, sir, I fell overboard off of the steamboat.”"}, {"id": "043-020-0012", "tag": "p", "text": "“Oh, you did, did you? Strike a light there, somebody. What did you say your name was?”", "sha256": "a975a1cb935d1d3eac2fdacda1e11a4a6672b43c7016262188d26aa5a6648a51", "source_location": "div.chapter[22]/*[12]", "source_html": "“Oh, you did, did you? Strike a light there, somebody. What did you say your name was?”"}, {"id": "043-020-0013", "tag": "p", "text": "“George Jackson, sir. I’m only a boy.”", "sha256": "3378916e1180afb393b5a2cc8995e045e7332f2eb53ceae436fc5b5517b09f22", "source_location": "div.chapter[22]/*[13]", "source_html": "“George Jackson, sir. I’m only a boy.”"}, {"id": "043-020-0014", "tag": "p", "text": "“Look here, if you’re telling the truth you needn’t be afraid—nobody’ll hurt you. But don’t try to budge; stand right where you are. Rouse out Bob and Tom, some of you, and fetch the guns. George Jackson, is there anybody with you?”", "sha256": "f8b6120303aa43b4389559860e4ca9fbeab2548d560eadc3e4e0b574ad576ab1", "source_location": "div.chapter[22]/*[14]", "source_html": "“Look here, if you’re telling the truth you needn’t be afraid—nobody’ll hurt you. But don’t try to budge; stand right where you are. Rouse out Bob and Tom, some of you, and fetch the guns. George Jackson, is there anybody with you?”"}, {"id": "043-020-0015", "tag": "p", "text": "“No, sir, nobody.”", "sha256": "3807e077513c58a66640c14d982948fe98e7fdfd2979e9fb573dd45a4babf944", "source_location": "div.chapter[22]/*[15]", "source_html": "“No, sir, nobody.”"}, {"id": "043-020-0016", "tag": "p", "text": "I heard the people stirring around in the house now, and see a light. The man sung out:", "sha256": "15484824b909f759635d1ac4190e516fb7c2a8f62bc69c592ccedb0407222592", "source_location": "div.chapter[22]/*[16]", "source_html": "I heard the people stirring around in the house now, and see a light. The man sung out:"}, {"id": "043-020-0017", "tag": "p", "text": "“Snatch that light away, Betsy, you old fool—ain’t you got any sense? Put it on the floor behind the front door. Bob, if you and Tom are ready, take your places.”", "sha256": "46524f63035dce0c8aca87a20a92a745d5a9bdaf2969b4f024a7ef2d0564c3b8", "source_location": "div.chapter[22]/*[17]", "source_html": "“Snatch that light away, Betsy, you old fool—ain’t you got any sense? Put it on the floor behind the front door. Bob, if you and Tom are ready, take your places.”"}, {"id": "043-020-0018", "tag": "p", "text": "“All ready.”", "sha256": "1204b9995749e71c1e909ef4bac5e47bfc9ce3d43b7c3cec9ab18e698dbfa3b6", "source_location": "div.chapter[22]/*[18]", "source_html": "“All ready.”"}, {"id": "043-020-0019", "tag": "p", "text": "“Now, George Jackson, do you know the Shepherdsons?”", "sha256": "d0cf57b7d8ce00513ff1998883ffd81a03db0d72fec77220324efac954af1c7b", "source_location": "div.chapter[22]/*[19]", "source_html": "“Now, George Jackson, do you know the Shepherdsons?”"}], "draft_rows": [{"source_id": "043-020-heading", "target": "ГЛАВА XVII.", "source_sha256": "1e12225a0a5a3223847dc745abeb5e3f9893423914ebf0dbe31f3498522ac869", "target_id": "ru-043-020-heading", "tag": "heading", "target_sha256": "1f0e782f00f4378a03f970f81ce2f8e3da9dfbe42365d94384516b98d7992580"}, {"source_id": "043-020-0001", "target": "Вечерний визит. — Ферма в Арканзаве. — Внутреннее убранство. — Стивен Доулинг Ботс. — Поэтические излияния.", "source_sha256": "1f78b931c63846b0a0191002dcb3b2b0a0f9710f5b23d4d6cfad399116be21f0", "target_id": "ru-043-020-0001", "tag": "source_argument", "target_sha256": "a21989af2b3586a3005e3ce682a6763fe95110a522e3ebd238fc6fbd542664f0"}, {"source_id": "043-020-0002", "target": "Примерно через минуту кто-то заговорил из окна, не высунув головы, и сказал:", "source_sha256": "fe47fadd8a5d4b58348209a077f6f39b7a66ad3fb9b86d63d938bbf968afa2a6", "target_id": "ru-043-020-0002", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "4ac5f1de3819f66089e489d5bbba69b303cfad4233078d1b3821483fdefe3e9f"}, {"source_id": "043-020-0003", "target": "«Хватит, ребята! Кто там?»", "source_sha256": "e41aa26cdc1636acc2366d7cd6703feea9a3b114d24bcaa23d80930c46b7387a", "target_id": "ru-043-020-0003", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "540798cb0b3e435044abd3d99f6e277431f77e2f3988bbec19b42c43f38ea34e"}, {"source_id": "043-020-0004", "target": "Я говорю:", "source_sha256": "0e568af30022d4c6b08be6c92743d85cbf120134610018b892e098e0fe72f7eb", "target_id": "ru-043-020-0004", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "fa163bba54dc6558fc348978f79413775cd345d5e175c50769a5d6e4566f034e"}, {"source_id": "043-020-0005", "target": "«Это я».", "source_sha256": "9a6667f7d13b4472b9483435994c5184e9c87f2e0c3717d478711bc38ad9d570", "target_id": "ru-043-020-0005", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "c1c40debf7fb4ef004594f8f8fdc92975ff70ac295d3a7a026adb5cc61989ddf"}, {"source_id": "043-020-0006", "target": "«Кто я?»", "source_sha256": "ec3534be495755274829d56e60d6573af1d582121f5ff13ca710f328dbecc201", "target_id": "ru-043-020-0006", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "5a6b0878caa103c0e2d7dc5e7dbde578889011d306fdc92c28fefe98fa8d7b36"}, {"source_id": "043-020-0007", "target": "«Джордж Джексон, сэр».", "source_sha256": "6d0b2403ade43ee63a16e4a3adccdf55c52a79daaf9d5d41a9c4a2e753a0471b", "target_id": "ru-043-020-0007", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "e7bf16f3a0e00ca81af17836fb3bb4f8a46e93af01bc46653a25fee80f9bb34f"}, {"source_id": "043-020-0008", "target": "«Чего тебе нужно?»", "source_sha256": "5af79f76f6b5043e967383b4ebbc976dcb4f8f9efcb66196e8fca17f326061c7", "target_id": "ru-043-020-0008", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "3c226718c55ce19c8db45228fa6ff3111055b149eb8293d0b65de5b31b5fc710"}, {"source_id": "043-020-0009", "target": "«Мне ничего не нужно, сэр. Я просто хочу пройти мимо, но собаки мне не дают».", "source_sha256": "0bff8040f1be86be586cd3e5101060dc1f9b6cba03a73634283123b7a75920fb", "target_id": "ru-043-020-0009", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "25ef30d324b1a003c375643223c4533af2ab198d8d8d6b101ab90346a7d80e58"}, {"source_id": "043-020-0010", "target": "«Чего ты тут рыскаешь в такую позднюю пору — а?»", "source_sha256": "bb5d19e8504ff710ff4bfb139aa907b0fe633fa4e03de56f9bf430a24224713b", "target_id": "ru-043-020-0010", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "b7076163e1a79af4e6b4000bf9e7511f186126c492bd0029ebe8a804d4b4f247"}, {"source_id": "043-020-0011", "target": "«Я не бродил по окрестностям, сэр, я упал за борт с парохода».", "source_sha256": "aedac23bb0edef0bcdd555e6866259c55fa96d26bd0b510d003785ea781ec700", "target_id": "ru-043-020-0011", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "d99fe28e03585190f4cca977d8a8e2512e9f851b9b1ca495a41ea2db431df558"}, {"source_id": "043-020-0012", "target": "«О, так ты это сделал, да? Кто-нибудь, зажгите там свет. Как, ты сказал, тебя зовут?»", "source_sha256": "a975a1cb935d1d3eac2fdacda1e11a4a6672b43c7016262188d26aa5a6648a51", "target_id": "ru-043-020-0012", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "d906f184cc014d6d2d647cd9b82d0342b1a1ec34ff462a2d7ce80f15306240b4"}, {"source_id": "043-020-0013", "target": "«Джордж Джексон, сэр. Я всего лишь мальчик».", "source_sha256": "3378916e1180afb393b5a2cc8995e045e7332f2eb53ceae436fc5b5517b09f22", "target_id": "ru-043-020-0013", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "1d5a5085b96ea6ac464603e2c9139c239b9ce8aa30c39a93d30a404eebca7a8f"}, {"source_id": "043-020-0014", "target": "«Слушай, если ты говоришь правду, тебе нечего бояться — никто не причинит тебе вреда. Но не пытайся сдвинуться с места; стой прямо там, где стоишь. Кто-нибудь из вас разбудите Боба и Тома и принесите ружья. Джордж Джексон, есть ли кто-нибудь с тобой?»", "source_sha256": "f8b6120303aa43b4389559860e4ca9fbeab2548d560eadc3e4e0b574ad576ab1", "target_id": "ru-043-020-0014", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "57135f162ce42e21fa882cb7b26a2a69ae50d786a8ad9e87a10e97b1c652d1c3"}, {"source_id": "043-020-0015", "target": "«Нет, сэр, никого».", "source_sha256": "3807e077513c58a66640c14d982948fe98e7fdfd2979e9fb573dd45a4babf944", "target_id": "ru-043-020-0015", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "8679c5c7da08d1348093cc6a0ff88721619e865d64a47173eef99186c75a2599"}, {"source_id": "043-020-0016", "target": "Я услышал, как люди зашумели в доме, и увидел свет. Мужчина воскликнул:", "source_sha256": "15484824b909f759635d1ac4190e516fb7c2a8f62bc69c592ccedb0407222592", "target_id": "ru-043-020-0016", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "7c5928deaa2146be410b103d2d38893d2ff52ed1a545fabed2430b4d0735f41a"}, {"source_id": "043-020-0017", "target": "«Убери этот фонарь, Бетси, ты, старая дура, — у тебя что, ума нет? Поставь его на пол за входной дверью. Боб, если ты и Том готовы, занимайте свои места».", "source_sha256": "46524f63035dce0c8aca87a20a92a745d5a9bdaf2969b4f024a7ef2d0564c3b8", "target_id": "ru-043-020-0017", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "54dca9178151339821d646c1c82653667fbd29cb9d11c9d5e69a0ea9d3ad39f9"}, {"source_id": "043-020-0018", "target": "«Всё готово».", "source_sha256": "1204b9995749e71c1e909ef4bac5e47bfc9ce3d43b7c3cec9ab18e698dbfa3b6", "target_id": "ru-043-020-0018", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "fb034753b8e32cc3c6654f779536ad60a18759f26a95a179dd62462e644ce43d"}, {"source_id": "043-020-0019", "target": "«Итак, Джордж Джексон, ты знаком с семьёй Шепердсонов?»", "source_sha256": "d0cf57b7d8ce00513ff1998883ffd81a03db0d72fec77220324efac954af1c7b", "target_id": "ru-043-020-0019", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "edcaa197b54abef03f86ff6a6cf4b5f968592ce8dd71f2426d4e30fb647258d4"}]}
